title: Llama dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- back legs -->
    <rect x='30' y='72' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#d9a066'/>
    <rect x='62' y='72' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#c08552'/>
    <!-- front legs -->
    <rect x='38' y='74' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#c08552'/>
    <rect x='54' y='74' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#d9a066'/>
    <!-- hooves -->
    <rect x='30' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <rect x='62' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <rect x='38' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <rect x='54' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
    <!-- dance skirt / tuft -->
    <path d='M26 60 Q50 50 74 60 L74 66 Q50 78 26 66 Z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
    <path d='M26 60 Q50 50 74 60 L74 66 Q50 78 26 66 Z' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <path d='M42 50 Q40 30 46 22 L56 22 Q60 32 58 50 Z' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='20' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <path d='M44 13 L42 4 L48 11 Z' fill='#e8cfa6'/>
    <path d='M60 13 L64 4 L58 11 Z' fill='#e8cfa6'/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='23' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8cfa6'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='21' r='1.2' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M54 24 Q57 26 60 24' stroke='#8a5a34' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- arms up dancing -->
    <path d='M40 55 Q28 46 24 36' stroke='#f5e6c8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M60 55 Q72 46 76 36' stroke='#f5e6c8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- raised hoof hands -->
    <circle cx='23' cy='34' r='4' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <circle cx='77' cy='34' r='4' fill='#6b4423'/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M26 58 Q18 54 20 48' stroke='#f5e6c8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
